description.value: Thai Corner is a well-established Thai restaurant on Sidney's main commercial strip, blending central and northeastern (I-San) Thai culinary traditions under a chef with over two decades of experience cooking in Thailand and abroad. The restaurant offers a broad menu of curries, spicy salads, stir-fries, and noodles with customizable spice levels, and serves both buffet-style lunch and à la carte dinner. Cyclists passing through Sidney-by-the-sea will find a sit-down meal, takeout, and even free delivery within downtown Sidney.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 36m; rack (4 spaces) at 81m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides the primary evidence. The address (2359 Beacon Ave, Sidney, BC), two phone numbers, and services (dine-in, takeout, delivery) are confirmed from the website; OSM had no address or phone to cross-check. Vegetarian and gluten-free options are explicitly supported ('We can modify any dish to be vegetarian and/or gluten free'). No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, water refill, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only. Website lists a second phone number (778) 351-3380 in addition to the primary (778) 426-4680.
No bike parking information available from OSM tags or website — a field visit would be needed to assess the streetscape.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established sit-down restaurant on Sidney's main street with takeout available and broad dietary accommodation; a clear useful food stop for touring cyclists on the Saanich Peninsula.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free delivery offered within downtown Sidney. A 15% gratuity is applied to groups of 6 or more.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'We can modify any dish to be vegetarian and/or gluten free' and the dinner page highlights vegetarian dishes specifically

wow_evidence: chef with over two decades of experience cooking in Thailand and abroad
